description: This source file defines a C# class 'Cookies' that provides methods to interact with browser cookies via JavaScript interop in a Blazor application.

classes.name: Cookies
classes.description: A class that encapsulates methods for deleting and retrieving cookies via JavaScript interop.

methods.description: Deletes a cookie with the specified name by invoking a JavaScript function.

methods.name: GetCookie
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a cookie with the specified name via JavaScript interop.
